env_line_malformed: can't parse {}: a line is malformed at character {} (the line isn't shown, it may hold a password)
clone_outlived: a clone of the test connection outlived the handler; the transaction rolls back when that clone is dropped
not_a_transaction: the test didn't run inside a transaction, so nothing could be rolled back
nested: runique_test can't run inside another runique_test: it would wait for its own caller forever
timed_out: the handler didn't finish within {} s: a deadlock, or a row another connection keeps locked? RUNIQUE_TEST_TIMEOUT in the env file changes the limit
bad_timeout: {} must be a whole number of seconds above 0, got "{}"
transaction_ended: the test's transaction was ended from inside the test (a COMMIT, or DDL on MySQL): everything written before that is now in the database
swallowed_failures: failed queries: {}, yet the handler returned Ok: an error got swallowed somewhere (wrap the failures you expect in expect_db_error)
rollback_timed_out: the rollback didn't finish within {} s
not_refused: the database accepted what the test expected it to refuse
no_db_config: the env file sets neither DATABASE_URL nor DB_ENGINE: the test database has to be named in it, nothing is taken from the shell
in_memory: in-memory: every test starts from an empty database
